promotions.title: 4 Systems, One Home
promotions.productName: Water Purifier, Air Purifier, Bidet, Massage Chair
promotions.summary: CUCKOO's current featured promotion spans all four main product categories: water purifier, air purifier, bidet, and massage chair. Each category has models at reduced sale pricing with flexible monthly rental plans starting at $19.99/mo.
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners outfitting a new home or upgrading multiple rooms at once
promotions.whyItStandsOut: Covers all four major categories under one rental program. Each system includes professional installation and its own service plan.

promotions.title: FIT Water Purifier
promotions.summary: The FIT Water Purifier (CP-MN031W) is currently listed at $509, down from $599. A compact countertop unit with self-cleaning technology, hot/cold/room-temperature dispensing, and quiet operation. Rental plans start at $19.99/mo under a Self Care plan.
promotions.bestFor: First-time renters and small households wanting entry-level purification with hands-off maintenance
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $90 off the regular price. The lowest available monthly rental rate in the CUCKOO lineup. Self-cleaning means no manual filter contact between scheduled deliveries.

promotions.title: Inspure Instant Heating Premium Bidet
promotions.productName: CUCKOO Inspure Instant Heating Premium Bidet
promotions.summary: CUCKOO is currently featuring their bidet lineup. The Inspure Instant Heating Premium Bidet (CBT-IS1131) includes instant heating, a 3-in-1 stainless steel self-cleaning nozzle, air drying, seat temperature adjustment, and remote control. Available for elongated and round toilet seats.
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners upgrading their bathroom who want instant heating and professional installation included
promotions.whyItStandsOut: Includes CUCKOO certified professional installation. The 3-in-1 stainless steel nozzle self-cleans before and after every use.

promotions.title: Room Care Smart Air Purifier
promotions.productName: CUCKOO Room Care Smart Air Purifier
promotions.summary: The Room Care Smart Air Purifier (CAC-C1020FW) is listed at $594, down from $699. Features real-time 6-color LED air quality indicators, automatic room-size detection, a dust sensor, and a dedicated baby mode. Runs continuously with whisper-quiet operation.
promotions.bestFor: Households with allergy concerns, pets, or young children
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $105 off the regular price. The 6-color real-time LED display shows air quality at a glance without needing an app.

promotions.title: Tower MAX Air Purifier
promotions.summary: The Tower MAX Air Purifier (CAC-D2020FW) is listed at $849, down from $999. A 360-degree purification tower with 8,200 air filtration pores for comprehensive room coverage and effective pet dander removal. The all-in-one filter simplifies replacement.
promotions.bestFor: Larger living spaces, open-plan homes, or households with multiple pets
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $150 off the regular price. The 360-degree design eliminates directional dead spots in coverage, effective for larger or irregularly shaped rooms.

promotions.title: Renature 3D Massage Chair
promotions.summary: The Renature 3D Massage Chair (CMS-D10SLGB) is listed at $4,499, reduced from $5,499. A full-body 3D massage chair with 12 automatic modes, foot rollers, full-body scan, zero-gravity positioning, Bluetooth speakers, and long-range remote.
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners who want a full-body recovery tool at home without a recurring gym or spa cost
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $1,000 off the regular price. A monthly rental option at $89/mo over 5 years removes the large upfront cost entirely.

promotions.title: Micro-Bubble Cleanser
promotions.summary: The Micro-Bubble Cleanser (CWS-AO201W) is listed at $509, down from $599. A shower-integrated microbubble system that generates nanobubbles to cleanse skin and hair without chemical additives. Installs inline with your existing showerhead.
promotions.bestFor: Anyone with sensitive skin, dry hair, or looking to reduce chemical exposure in their daily shower routine
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $90 off the regular price. Works with your existing shower setup and requires no specialized maintenance between scheduled filter services.
